notes.title: Giant Cop Update – Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Hey Micro City visitors,

We are happy to bring you our first Steam patch for both Vive and Oculus Users, the following optimizations and bug fixes have been implemented:

[list]
[*]Add Haptic feedback to Vive controls
[*]Added disconnect prompts for Oculus Rift hardware
[*]Fixed an error where the shake gesture recognition required more force than intended
[*]Fixed an error where the “Quit to Steam” button didn’t show text with French Language enabled
[*]Additional bug-fixes & stability improvements
[/list] 

Thanks everyone for your feedback and support.   If you find something you want to report please email us at support@giantcop.com

Cheers!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Giant Cop: Justice Above All
notes.notes:
Giant Cop: Justice Above All is Now Available on Steam!

Giant Missions, Giant Fun in pint sized Micro City. You are the Giant Cop. Use your size to your advantage to explore the open world, find hidden interactive objects and tower over the city uncovering a criminal plot that threatens Micro City.



Giant Cop is a satirical, narrative driven game, a vibrant, 70s styled open world with a sandbox design, giving you the freedom to fight crime in a giant way.

notes.title: Giant Cop s E3 Trailer Depicts Long VR Arm Of The Law
notes.notes:
Giant Cop: Justice Above All [official site] is a game that understands what it is. It’s named Giant Cop because you play as a giant cop. Reminiscent of a 70s cop show, you band around a faux west-coast American town named Micro City as its lone law enforcer and, using a VR headset and motion controls, pick up criminals and literally throw them in jail. It’s as tongue-in-cheek as it sounds and developers Other Ocean Interactive dropped a new trailer at E3 this week. Observe:
